page.layout: One column of running text. Printed quotation marks („) stand in the left margin beside each line, so they are not notes. Above the text, a page number at the left and a running head at the top centre (ornamented, not legible). No notes, no footer.

main_text.p: minetur. Aut si neque de fa-to, neque de facti appellatio ne ambigi poteft, id quod arguere, neges tale effe, quale illedicat, & rectum effe quod feceris, concedendum ue defendas. Ita primus ille status & quasi conflictio cum aduerfario, coniectura quadam: secundus autem, definitione, atque descriptione, aut informatione uerbi: tertius æqui, & ueri & recti disputatione tractandus eft. Et quoniam semper is qui defendit non solum resistat oportet aliquo statu aut inficiando, aut defi-niendo, aut æquitate opponenda: sed etiam ratione obijciat

page.notes: Left-margin „ marks are quotation-style ornaments repeated per line; not transcribed as text. The running head at top centre is decorated and not reliably legible. The text is a single column; the hyphen in "fa-to" and "defi-niendo" and "infor-matione" follows the printed line breaks. Long s was normalised to s (e.g. "fi", "fecundus", "femper", "folum", "fed", "quafi", "ftatus"), per the page rules. Some letters are faint; "cõiectura" keeps the printed tilde for n. "eft" and "feceris" are kept as printed.
